name: QUCHMIC
summary: QUCHMIC, also known as BB-22, SGT-32, or quinolin-8-yl 1-cyclohexylmethyl-1H-indole-3-8-carboxylate, is a designer drug offered by online vendors as a cannabimimetic agent, and was first detected being sold in synthetic cannabis products in Japan in early 2013, and subsequently also in New Zealand.

pharmacology.text: QUCHMIC acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 0.217 nM at CB1 and 0.338 nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: QUCHMIC (named using EMCDDA naming standards, but regularly mis-named QUCHIC), also known as BB-22, SGT-32, or quinolin-8-yl 1-cyclohexylmethyl-1H-indole-3-8-carboxylate, is a designer drug offered by online vendors as a cannabimimetic agent, and was first detected being sold in synthetic cannabis products in Japan in early 2013, and subsequently also in New Zealand.

summaryZh: QUCHIC（開發代號：BB-22、SGT-32，化學名：1-(環己基甲基)-1H-吲哚-3-甲酸-8-羥基喹啉酯，1--1H-indole-3-carboxylic acid 8-quinolinyl ester）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C25H24N2O2，屬於人工合成的大麻素。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cannabinoids as a group can cause anxiety, paranoia, a racing heart, vomiting, confusion and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths. Regular use can lead to dependence and difficult withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整體而言可能引起焦慮、偏執、心跳過快、嘔吐、意識混亂和精神病症狀，也曾與癲癇發作、腎損傷、心臟病發作和死亡有關。規律使用可能導致依賴和難熬的戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。合成大麻素整体而言可能引起焦虑、偏执、心跳过快、呕吐、意识混乱和精神病症状，也曾与癫痫发作、肾损伤、心脏病发作和死亡有关。规律使用可能导致依赖和难熬的戒断症状。

fact.en: QUCHMIC, better known as BB-22, is one of the synthetic cannabinoids designated SGT by their maker. It joins an indole to a quinoline ring through an ester link.
fact.zh: QUCHMIC 更常被稱為 BB-22，是製造者以 SGT 編號的合成大麻素之一。它透過酯鍵把吲哚和喹啉環連在一起。
fact.zhHans: QUCHMIC 更常被称为 BB-22，是制造者以 SGT 编号的合成大麻素之一。它通过酯键把吲哚和喹啉环连在一起。
